source_cutoffs.interpretation: Distinct retained observation/review cutoffs; release assembly does not refresh every source.

blockers: Instrument population and applicability review incomplete.
Entity lifecycle, mandate links and accepted ownership not fully verified.
Evidence intake/authority not obtained; synthetic rehearsals are software tests only.
No accepted operational/financial adjudications or independent institutional review.
No intervention has institutional approval or observed realization.

population_rule: All filesystem files under declared prefixes, including ready untracked files; explicit exclusions and transient Python caches omitted. Not derived from git tracking or current HEAD.

exclusions.data/portfolio/release_manifest.json: Self hash excluded to avoid a circular manifest; manifest is verified by regeneration.
exclusions.docs/portfolio_release.md: Rendered manifest companion excluded to avoid a circular output dependency.
exclusions.README.md: Generated navigation consumes current status; checked separately by navigation validation.
exclusions.metadata/current_status.json: Generated combined status may consume this manifest; validated separately.
exclusions.docs/current_status.md: Generated combined status may consume this manifest; validated separately.
exclusions.metadata/project_health.json: Generated structural health may consume release controls; validated separately.
exclusions.docs/project_health.md: Generated structural health may consume release controls; validated separately.
exclusions.metadata/readme_navigation.json: Generated navigation receipt may consume combined status; validated separately.
exclusions.metadata/workflow_execution.json: Runtime/orchestration receipt is separate from deterministic artifact identity.
exclusions.docs/workflow_execution.md: Runtime/orchestration receipt is separate from deterministic artifact identity.
exclusions.data/portfolio/workflow_execution.json: Runtime/orchestration receipt is separate from deterministic artifact identity.
exclusions.docs/portfolio_agent_review.md: Separate-agent final review may examine this manifest; excluding avoids review/hash cycle.

runtime_validation: NOT_ATTESTED_BY_THIS_MANIFEST; use exact-commit hosted/local validation receipts separately.
privacy_limit: Rejects restricted/secret path patterns and symlinks; not a content-level security certification. Approved public derivatives and separate boundary validation remain required.
refresh_rule: Rebuild after all source edits and before final validation. Any eligibility/benefit change requires substantive review and a new release policy, not merely updated hashes.
